tools.name: get_agent_discovery
tools.description: Fetch one of georgian.io's machine-readable discovery documents by name: api-catalog (RFC 9727 linkset), openapi (OpenAPI 3.1), mcp-server-card, agent-skills (skills index), or auth (agent authentication policy).

tools.name: get_page_markdown
tools.description: Return the current georgian.io page as clean Markdown (title, summary, key entities, cross-references, actions, and schema.org structured data). Works best on the core pages: /, /for-ceos, /for-investors, /ai-lab.

tools.name: list_site_pages
tools.description: List the primary georgian.io routes an agent can navigate to, flagging which ones support Accept: text/markdown negotiation. Use this to plan navigation before fetching.
